text: Share your mobile data plan freely with your tablet and laptop.
By joining forces with others, you help make the Internet better, faster and more reliable for everyone starting with yourself.

Connect with Facebook to see friends who share their Internet near you!

We never post anything without your permission.
Install Open Garden on your tablet

Open Garden connects laptops and Android tablets to your phone.

Install Open Garden from Google Play or http://opengarden.com on any Android, Windows, or OS X device you want to connect to.
